semiconductor_relevance: High — Sinfonia Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in equipment solutions for both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes.
summary: Sinfonia Technology Co., Ltd. provides advanced transport system solutions tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on automation and efficiency. Their product lineup includes various load ports and environmental control systems designed to enhance both front-end and back-end processes.

regional_presence.Japan: The company has expanded its manufacturing capabilities with facilities in Toyohashi.
